{{Top|leg}}
'''Kevlex''' was a material that was combined with high-grade [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> to create [[duravlex]].<ref name="Scavenger">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref> It used by [[Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines/Legends|Roche Hive Mechanical]] to make the alloy which covered its [[8D smelter droid]] design.<ref name="EGTD" />
